dashboard.label: Frothly intrusion overview
dashboard.description: One KPI per shipped detection across the six BOTS v3 scenarios. Red means the detection is firing on the data in the selected window.

single.title: AWS Console login without MFA (IAM user)

search.query: index=botsv3 sourcetype=aws:cloudtrail eventName=ConsoleLogin additionalEventData.MFAUsed=No userIdentity.type=IAMUser | stats count min(_time) as firstTime values(sourceIPAddress) as src_ip by userIdentity.userName | rename userIdentity.userName as user | stats count

single.title: Remote interactive/network logon from external source

search.query: index=botsv3 EventCode=4624 (Logon_Type=3 OR Logon_Type=10) | eval is_external=if(match(Source_Network_Address, "^\d{1,3}(\.\d{1,3}){3}$") AND NOT cidrmatch("10.0.0.0/8", Source_Network_Address) AND NOT cidrmatch("172.16.0.0/12", Source_Network_Address) AND NOT cidrmatch("192.168.0.0/16", Source_Network_Address) AND NOT cidrmatch("127.0.0.0/8", Source_Network_Address), 1, 0) | where is_external=1 | stats count by host, Source_Network_Address, Account_Name | stats count

index=botsv3 sourcetype=stream:dns (query=*coinhive.com OR query=*minexmr.com OR query=*nanopool.org OR query=*xmrpool.* OR query=*cryptonight.*) | stats count dc(query) as distinct_fqdns values(query) as fqdns by src_ip | stats count

index=botsv3 sourcetype=XmlWinEventLog:Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational EventCode=1 Image=*powershell.exe (CommandLine=*FromBase64String* OR CommandLine=*-enc*) | stats count values(CommandLine) as cmdlines by Computer, User | stats count

single.title: PowerShell launched by the Task Scheduler (svchost)

search.query: index=botsv3 sourcetype=XmlWinEventLog:Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational EventCode=1 Image=*powershell.exe ParentImage=*svchost.exe | stats count by Computer, User, ParentCommandLine | stats count

single.title: Azure AD sign-in from outside North America

search.query: index=botsv3 sourcetype=ms:aad:signin loginStatus=Success NOT (location.country=US OR location.country=CA) | stats count values(location.country) as countries by userPrincipalName, ipAddress | stats count

single.title: Azure AD failed sign-ins across multiple accounts

search.query: index=botsv3 sourcetype=ms:aad:signin loginStatus=Failure | stats dc(userPrincipalName) as users count as failures | where users>=3 | stats count

single.title: O365 file exposed by an anonymous sharing link

search.query: index=botsv3 sourcetype=ms:o365:management Operation=AnonymousLinkCreated | stats count values(SourceFileName) as files by UserId, ClientIP | stats count

single.title: O365 Set-Mailbox run by a regular mailbox user

search.query: index=botsv3 sourcetype=ms:o365:management Operation=Set-Mailbox UserId=*@froth.ly | stats count values(ObjectId) as targets by UserId | stats count
